Title: Generally Available: Data API in vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
Now you can interact with your Mongo DB data directly from your applications through a simple RESTful, HTTPS interface. The Data API for vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for Mongo DB eliminates the need for traditional database drivers or complex queries. The Data API gives you a streamlined, user-friendly way to perform basic operations, simplifying the connection stream between your MongoDB data and your web apps, mobile apps, and visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI.   

Learn more.
